synthetic.statement: Every value in this file is invented. No production data, no personal data, no real person, no real address and no real domain. Every origin is .synthetic.invalid or a loopback port.

title: LedgerFlow processed transactions — the P-3 population
addendum_reference: A.1 LedgerFlow; C P-3; D golden dataset requirements
population_rule: currency = USD and amount >= 100000 and processed_time within period
boundary: USD 100,000.00 is INCLUDED. It is the PoC's exercised tolerance boundary (FR-9).
notes: Money is a decimal amount as a string plus an ISO 4217 currency (addendum B). No foreign-exchange conversion.
TX-500008 appears twice with the same transaction_id: the duplicate primary key case.
TX-500007 has no processed_time: the missing mandatory value case.
TX-500010 is one cent under the threshold and TX-500011 is not USD; both are outside the population on purpose.
TX-500012's memo carries a prompt-like string. It is DATA and is served verbatim.
